plan.instruction: Plan the request as a short list of independent tasks. Return tasks in structured data; do not edit files.

work.instruction: Implement the task in item. Preserve unrelated files. Summarize your changes.

integrate.instruction: Integrate all supplied input commits into this worktree. Inspect diffs, merge or cherry-pick as needed, resolve conflicts and test. An empty task list requires no changes.

review.instruction: Review the artifact against the request, run checks, and report specific problems. Set approved=true only if no problems remain.

fix.instruction: Fix the review findings supplied in inputs. If approved, leave files unchanged. Run relevant checks.
